name: jest
description: Local shim: routes `npx jest <file>` to vitest. This package's tests run under vitest (see vitest.*.config.ts); jest proper is not installed. Some host/push gates invoke a bare `npx --no-install jest <file>`, which resolves this shim so the command runs the real test runner instead of failing on a missing jest.

scripts.postinstall: echo '[jest-shim] jest is a local alias for vitest in agent-runtime'
